name: shiori-sh
title: Shiori
description: Search, save, and manage your Shiori bookmarks. Mark links as read, delete them, save from clipboard, and track unread count in the menu bar.
author: 0xdhrv

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Your Shiori API key (starts with shk_). Get one at shiori.sh → Settings → API.

commands.name: search-links
commands.title: Search Links
commands.description: Browse, filter, and manage your saved Shiori links

commands.name: save-link
commands.title: Save Link
commands.description: Save a URL to your Shiori library

commands.name: save-tab
commands.title: Save Current Tab
commands.description: Save the currently open browser tab to Shiori

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Unread Links
commands.description: Show unread Shiori link count in the menu bar

tools.name: save-link
tools.title: Save Link
tools.description: Save a URL to the user's Shiori bookmark library. Use this when the user wants to save, bookmark, or store a link for later reading. The URL is required, title is optional.

tools.name: search-links
tools.title: Search Links
tools.description: Search the user's Shiori bookmarks by title, URL, or domain. Returns matching links with their details. Use this when the user wants to find, look up, or search for saved bookmarks by topic or keyword.

tools.name: mark-read
tools.title: Mark as Read
tools.description: Mark a bookmark as read. Requires the link ID. Use this when the user has finished reading an article and wants to mark it as completed.

tools.name: mark-unread
tools.title: Mark as Unread
tools.description: Mark a bookmark as unread, moving it back to the inbox. Requires the link ID. Use this when the user wants to re-read something or keep it in their reading list.

tools.name: delete-link
tools.title: Delete Link
tools.description: Permanently delete a bookmark from the user's Shiori library. Requires the link ID. Use this when the user explicitly wants to remove a saved link. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: get-unread
tools.title: Get Unread Links
tools.description: Retrieve all unread bookmarks from the user's Shiori library. Returns a list of links that haven't been read yet. Use this when the user wants to see their reading list or what they have saved to read.

tools.name: get-recent
tools.title: Get Recent Links
tools.description: Retrieve recently saved bookmarks from the user's Shiori library. Returns the most recently added links. Use this when the user wants to see what they've saved lately.

ai.instructions: When the user asks to save, bookmark, search, or manage links, or asks about their reading list or unread/saved items, use the Shiori tools. Always use the appropriate tool rather than declining.
